body.objective: Students will be able to use radicals to guess meaning.
body.iCan: I can use radicals to guess meaning.
successCriteria: I can identify common radicals and their meanings
I can use radicals and context to guess unknown characters
I can read a short text in characters with support
body.hook: Chinese has thousands of characters, but you don't need to memorize each from scratch. Most are built from parts, and one part, the radical, often hints at the meaning. 河 (river), 海 (sea) and 湖 (lake) all share the water radical 氵.

vocabulary.definition: Radical, the part of a character that hints at meaning.

study.title: 读汉字 Dú Hànzì
study.question: How can radicals and context help me read new characters?
study.passage:
Common radicals:
氵water: 河 hé river, 海 hǎi sea, 洗 xǐ wash, 湖 hú lake
口 mouth: 吃 chī eat, 喝 hē drink, 叫 jiào call, 唱 chàng sing
木 tree/wood: 林 lín forest, 树 shù tree, 桌 zhuō table
亻person: 你 nǐ you, 他 tā he, 住 zhù live, 休 xiū rest (person leaning on a tree!)
讠speech: 说 shuō speak, 话 huà words, 语 yǔ language
女 woman: 妈 mā mother, 姐 jiě older sister, 好 hǎo good
扌hand: 打 dǎ hit/play, 拿 ná take, 找 zhǎo look for
日 sun: 明 míng bright, 早 zǎo early, 星 xīng star
Reading strategy: 1) Read the whole sentence. 2) Look at the radical of the unknown character. 3) Use context. 4) Guess, then check with a dictionary app.
短文 Short text:
我家住在海边。每天早上，我和姐姐去海边跑步。妈妈在家里做早饭。我们回家以后，一起吃饭、喝茶。周末，我们去树林里休息，听鸟唱歌。
Wǒ jiā zhù zài hǎibiān. Měitiān zǎoshang, wǒ hé jiějie qù hǎibiān pǎobù. Māma zài jiā lǐ zuò zǎofàn. Wǒmen huí jiā yǐhòu, yìqǐ chīfàn, hē chá. Zhōumò, wǒmen qù shùlín lǐ xiūxi, tīng niǎo chànggē.
Task: Circle every character with a radical from the list and guess its meaning. Then answer comprehension questions.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Read the short text and circle radicals
discussion: Which radical was easiest to spot?
How did context help you guess meaning?
Why is 休 (rest) a person beside a tree?
When might a radical mislead you?
study.product: Create a radical poster with six radicals and three example characters each, and read the short text aloud, explaining how you figured out three new characters.
